name: Lenovo
verdict: About a tenth indirectly owned by the Chinese state, through Legend Holdings.
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): CAS Holdings (wholly state-owned) holds 29.04% of Legend, which holds 32.95% of Lenovo: about 9.5% through the chain.

why.text: Lenovo’s largest shareholder is Legend Holdings, with about a third, and Legend’s largest shareholder, with 29%, is a company wholly owned by the Chinese state. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that China committed serious human rights violations against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So part of the money behind Lenovo is the Chinese state’s.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.
